rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for describing a person who is elderly.

example.english: My grandma is elderly and needs someone to accompany her when she goes out.
example.traditional: 我阿嫲年紀大，出街要有人陪。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa4 nin4 gei2 daai6 ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 jau5 jan4 pui4

rows.note: Use this for an old object that is worn, frail, or dated rather than for an elderly person.

example.english: This elderly, worn-out phone keeps failing to get a signal.
example.traditional: 呢部電話又殘舊，成日都收唔到訊號。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 jau6 caan4 gau6 seng4 jat6 dou1 sau1 m4 dou2 seon3 hou6
